      "name": "rpc",

      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds long-requested UNIX domain socket support to the RPC server and bitcoin-cli, closing issue #5029 open since 2014. This enables local callers to bypass TCP loopback overhead and leverage OS filesystem permissions instead of IP-based filtering via -rpcallowip."

      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
